purpose: Shows rows of records in columns so they can be compared, sorted and chosen, with keyboard navigation cell by cell.

props.name: columns
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; sortable?: boolean; align?: 'start' | 'end' }>
props.description: Columns; the first is the row header

props.name: rows
props.type: Array<{ id: string; cells: Record<string, React.ReactNode> }>
props.description: Rows, with a cell per column id

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a sortable header is pressed

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Row selection; multiple adds a selection column. Defaults to none

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the selected row ids

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no rows. Defaults to No results

whenToUse: To compare records across several attributes
When users sort, scan or act on many rows
whenNotToUse: For a simple list of items — use List
For layout — use the grid tokens
antiPatterns: Putting interactive controls in every cell

anatomy: A bordered grid with a sticky sunken header row, 1px row dividers, optional selection column, sort chevrons and an empty state
states: Header `color-background-sunken` with a `color-border-input` rule; row hover `color-state-layer`; selected `color-container-primary`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: role grid named by the label; column headers report aria-sort
Arrow keys move cell by cell; Space selects rows
The first column is the row header
